From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Singh <rajiv@novacare.io>, Emma Harper <emma.harper@novacare.io>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 12:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal and pilot economics

Rajiv / Emma —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick sketch of two credit structures that keep economics simple for your CFO: 

Option A — Fixed anchor credit:
- $45,000 one-time credit applied to first-month invoice only.
- Covers both hosted API token spend and Dedicated burst minutes during pilot.
- Rationale: simplifies accounting and avoids per-token reconciliation.

Option B — Variable benchmark credit (preferred for alignment):
- $60,000 total credit allocated across first 90 days on a decaying schedule: 50% month 1, 30% month 2, 20% month 3.
- Applies to hosted API usage first; Dedicated burst minutes draw down from remaining credit if used.
- Requires short attestation (simple usage report) at month boundaries.

Notes: Option B aligns incentives — larger offset at start when integration costs are highest and steps down as usage normalizes. It also reduces short-term cash impact on Novacare while preserving commercial upside for Redwood after credits are exhausted.

Request: We can offer Option B but it needs internal approval from VP / CFO due to the size and because it cross-applies across product modalities. Can I escalate this internally and loop in Marissa and Karthik for signoff? If approved, we will: 1) bake the credit schedule into the SOW, 2) include an accounting clause that credit applies only during pilot months and not to post-pilot committed usage, and 3) provide monthly usage reports.

Best,
Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv@novacare.io>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Variable benchmark credit petition for strategic pilot - VP/CFO signoff required

Marissa / Karthik —

Forwarding a quick thread with Novacare. They asked for a decaying, 90-day variable benchmark credit (Option B above). High level: strategic prospect (digital cardiology integration), estimated 3-month pilot spend ~$120k run-rate across hosted + occasional dedicated bursts. Proposed credit $60k (50/30/20).

Why I think this is reasonable:
- Strategic: Novacare has strong channel potential in the hospital systems vertical and could accelerate a paid rollout after pilot.
- Risk mitigation: credit reduces their integration friction and protects procurement approval timelines.
- Upside: pilot consumption likely to scale beyond credit — we retain full post-pilot pricing and potential committed ARR.

Requested approvals / asks for internal signoff:
1) VP commercial signoff to grant the $60k variable credit as a one-time pilot concession (not recurring).
2) CFO signoff to confirm accounting treatment: apply credit to hosted API invoices first and allow dedicated-minute drawdown if remaining.
3) Confirmation on required DocuSign language (I propose clause: "Pilot benchmark credit applies only to invoice line items generated during the 90-day pilot, not to subsequent committed usage; credits are non-refundable and non-transferable.")

Attachments: pilot-economics-worksheet.xlsx (calc of runway + expected invoice cadence), novacare-proposal-v2.pdf

I tried to keep the ask narrow. If you want a smaller anchor (e.g., $40k) I can push that. We need a decision by EOD Thu to keep Novacare's procurement timeline.

Thanks —
Camila

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv@novacare.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Variable benchmark credit petition for strategic pilot - VP/CFO signoff required

Camila —

Thanks for the clear memo and the economics worksheet. I reviewed the numbers and spoke briefly with Finance. High level decision: we will approve a modified Variable Benchmark Credit, conditional on the following: 

1) Final credit = $52,500 allocated across 90 days on a 45/35/20 split (month 1/month 2/month 3).
2) Applies first to hosted API usage; Dedicated minute drawdown allowed only if hosted consumption exceeds 80% of expected pilot baseline (protects carrier capacity economics).
3) Novacare must sign an amendment to the SOW with the following clauses: credit schedule, explicit non-transferability, and a 14-day reconciliation window after each month with Redwood's usage report as the source of truth.
4) Legal to include a short clawback clause: if Novacare cancels the pilot before day 30 without documented technical blockers, remaining credit is forfeited.

Karthik — please confirm accounting code to book the credit (I suggested: GA-COGS-PilotCredits-2028Q2) and confirm that we can treat the credit as contra-revenue for the pilot period only. If Finance OK, Camila please request DocuSign and send final SOW amendment to Rajiv for signature.

Rajiv — pleased to move forward — see attached revised credit schedule (I will have Legal draft amendment). We expect to have the DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow once Finance confirms booking code.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
